source.doc_type: CAR disclosure with reviewed condensed interim financial statements 2Q2026 (Thai)

notes: Quarterly (6 months to 30 June 2026 = year to date). File named TIPLIFE (Dhipaya Life Assurance). CAR disclosure p.2-3, reviewed statements (EY) from p.5; scanned, read locally, pages located by their headings (file page numbers). Units differ: the SCI (three months p.8, six months p.10) is in Baht, the notes in thousand Baht. No PAA business. Issued contracts are reported in two portfolio groups: note 5 (ordinary and others) and note 6 (credit group). Revenue and expenses from note 4 total column, six months 2569 (p.20; p.18 is three months 2569, p.19 and p.21 the 2568 comparatives). CSM roll-forward = sum of the CSM columns of 5.2 (p.24) and 6.2 (p.29), six months; new business = 5.3 (p.26) + 6.3 (p.31) totals. Each summed item records the note 5 page; the heading names the note 6 page. Future-service change = change in estimates + experience adjustment (CSM column; group 6 change in estimates nil). Other revenue = รายการอื่น (note 4). Other expense = other operating expenses (no separate other finance cost line). The three-month profit or loss is the SCI for the three months to 30 June 2569 (p.8).
